{{Article header|deck=A field reference for Radicoida Unica, including value, sampling distance, environmental profiles and known visual variants.}}

{{Exobiology species infobox}}

'''Radicoida Unica''' is a rare plant first catalogued in HIP 87621. Frontier reports describe the known specimens as thriving on hot planets with thin atmospheres, but that report is not an exhaustive spawn specification.<ref name="canonn">[https://us-central1-canonn-api-236217.cloudfunctions.net/query/codex/ref Canonn Codex reference], snapshot retrieved 28 September 2026.</ref><ref name="hip-access">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/galnet/pilots-federation-members-enter-hip-87621 Pilots’ Federation Members Enter HIP 87621], Frontier Developments, 13 November 3311.</ref>

== Identification ==

The Codex does not record a separately named colour variant. Its public display name is Radicoida Unica; the internal journal species token retains the form <code>Unicus</code>.

== Practical notes ==

HIP 87621 access is restricted to licensed Commanders, and Fleet Carriers are excluded from the system.
